title: Version A clips: image-to-video per shot
judge_notes: File names are shot ids: clips/cut/S03.mp4 is the window of shot S03 used in the cut (raw takes are in clips/raw/). Each take was generated from its keyframe as the first frame; only the used window matters, usually the first (end - start) seconds. The clip's own audio is discarded.

questions.text: Does every live shot have a clip at least as long as the shot?
Is every clip in the screenplay's aspect?
Is every clip prompt free of requests to draw text, a logo or a number plate?
Did every clip pass its take checks within max_takes (none flagged)?
Does each clip start from its keyframe and keep the same people, wardrobe and place?
In the used window, does each clip show only the one small action its shot asks for?
In the used window, does nobody enter or leave frame and no new person or object appear?
Are faces and hands stable in the used window (no morphing, melting or extra fingers)?
Is every clip free of text, letters, logos, emblems and number plates?
questions.evidence: Quote nothing for a yes; for a no, name the file and where the text or mark is.

questions.text: Is the camera move the one the shot names?
questions.evidence: Name any clip with the wrong move.

questions.text: Is motion natural (blinks, breathing, weight) with no sliding or floating?
Do light and colour stay like the keyframe through the used window?
